EX-99.1 2 exhibit991q42026earningsre.htm EX-99.1 EARNINGS RELEASE Document Exhibit 99.1 Investor Relations Contact:Mike Sullivan (408) 986-7977mike_sullivan@amat.com Media Contact:Ricky Gradwohl (408) 235-4676ricky_gradwohl@amat.com APPLIED MATERIALS ANNOUNCES FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS •Record quarterly revenue $10.41 billion, up 53 percent year over year•Quarterly GAAP gross margin 50.4 percent and non-GAAP gross margin 50.6 percent, up 240 basis points and 250 basis points year over year, respectively•Quarterly GAAP EPS $3.40 and record non-GAAP EPS $4.16, up 43 percent and 92 percent year over year, respectively•Record annual revenue $34.45 billion, up 21 percent year over year•Annual GAAP gross margin 50.0 percent and non-GAAP gross margin 50.1 percent, both up 130 basis points year over year•Record annual GAAP EPS $12.62 and record non-GAAP EPS $12.89, up 46 percent and 37 percent year over year, respectively•Unveiled the EPIC Center in Silicon Valley and added four new R&D partnerships, bringing our total number of announced EPIC engagements to 15SANTA CLARA, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 — Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMAT) today reported results for its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended Oct. 25, 2026. Fourth Quarter ResultsApplied generated record revenue of $10.41 billion. On a GAAP basis, the company reported gross margin of 50.4 percent, record operating income of $3.66 billion or 35.1 percent of revenue, and earnings per share (EPS) of $3.40.On a non-GAAP basis, the company reported gross margin of 50.6 percent, record operating income of $3.68 billion or 35.3 percent of revenue, and record EPS of $4.16.The company generated record cash from operations of $3.30 billion and distributed $2.42 billion to shareholders through $2.
